connector.name: Gmem
connector.registryDescription: Persistent, Solana-aware project memory for AI coding agents. Typed entities + git-aware diffs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gmem. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yksanjo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: GMEM_DB
env.description: Override the auto-resolved memory database path. Defaults to ~/.gmem/<projectHash>/memory.db, with one db file per Solana project (project root resolved from Anchor.toml or workspace Cargo.toml).
